guidelines: Each transcript is one turn of a session in datasets/sessions/stackprep-snapshot.json: the conversation up to and including that answer, the evidence examined so far, and the hand-written interview state. Every sample starts from a fresh store, so the K samples of a transcript send identical requests.

expected is the human judgement of the answer against the pinned snapshot: strong (accurate and specific), weak (contradicts the code or is unsupported), mixed (partly right or openly unsure). It feeds only the strong-above-weak sanity check, never the variability metrics.
Labels were set from the session descriptions and the snapshot code, before any evaluation output was seen.

transcripts.why: Claims buildReportInput passes discrepancy_detail; it passes only the boolean.
Accurate list of the fenced evaluation prompt blocks.
Claims a keyword heuristic fallback that does not exist; the tool returns a failure.
Accurate account of the focus rules and scrubbing.
Claims planner memory is unbounded; buildPlanningInput applies budgets.
